response.text: {"question":"As of 28 May 2023, how does a MiFID investment firm interpret references to ‘authorisation’, ‘obligations’, ‘investment services and activities’, ‘client’, and ‘competent authority’ under the PRA’s outsourcing requirements?","answer":"The firm treats ‘authorisation’ as authorisation under section 31(2) of the Act; ‘obligations’ as its obligations under the regulatory system; ‘investment services and activities’ as the relevant services and activities; ‘client’ as any client; and ‘competent authority’ as the PRA or FCA when they act outside their role as a competent authority for MiFID II or CRR.","answerable":true}
